generate_project_structure: generate a hierarchical dictionary of a project's directory structure using ProjectStructureGenerator
format_project_tree: format a project structure dictionary into a human-readable tree text with indentation
check_ignore_pattern: check if a file or directory path should be ignored based on configured patterns
generate_structure_with_depth: generate a project structure dictionary limited to a specified maximum traversal depth
run_repo_tree_cli: run the repo_tree CLI to output a project directory tree as text or JSON
